system.description:
You infuse chakra into your eyes, allowing you the ability to see in the dark. For the duration, you 60ft of Darkvision.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, you can select +1 creature other than yourself to benefit from this jutsu’s effects. For every rank about C-Rank you cast this jutsu, increase the number of creatures you can bestow this jutsu’s effects by +2.
